meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 里你指定的代理组装上 Tavily 搜索和网址提取两个远程工具；之后它能应你要求搜索网页或提取网页内容，调用时无需 API key；免费额度用完后，代理会引导你改用 API key 继续用。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 的某个代理组安装 Tavily 网页搜索或网址提取，并且不想提供 API key 时触发。

say.text: 把 Tavily 也加到 work 组，装完重启并验证一次搜索。
say.note: 只会保留 Search 和 Extract 两个工具。

say.text: Tavily 提示免费额度耗尽，帮我配置 API key 继续用。
say.note: 需要第 5 步的升级指引已写入该组。

howto.what_en: Adds Tavily Search and URL extraction as remote tools for the NanoClaw agent groups you choose. The agent can then search the web or pull page content without an API key; when the free allowance runs out it guides you to switch to an API key.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want Tavily web search or URL extraction set up for a NanoClaw agent group without providing an API key.

say_en.text: Install Tavily Search and Extract on the devel group without an API key.
say_en.note: Registers the tavily server and restarts the group.

say_en.text: Add Tavily to the work group too, then restart and verify one search.
say_en.note: Only Search and Extract stay available.

say_en.text: Tavily says my free allowance is used up; help me set up an API key.
say_en.note: Needs the Phase-5 upgrade instructions present.
